newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: FORECAST-Strong demand ups Chemserve yr shr.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Strong demand ups Chemserve yr shr.

text.p: Chemical Services Ltd is expected to post slightly higher year earnings on the back of robust domestic demand and contributions from a number of projects commissioned last year, analysts said on Wednesday.
"I think the company has been doing quite well...I think the domestic market has been good for their performance," said Wynand van Zyl, a chemicals analyst at SMK Securities.
Analysts polled by Reuters forecast Chemserve's earnings rising to between 75 and 78.5 cents with consensus at 76.8 cents from 67.3 cents a year ago -- a rise of 14 percent.
They put the dividend at between 23 and 26 cents with consensus at 24.3 versus 21 cents before.
Chemserve, a manufacturer and seller of a wide range of chemical raw materials, is due to report results for the 12 months to December 31 on Monday.
"A number of expansion projects that were commissioned last year are expected to increase their production lines and that should contribute to earnings," van Zyl said.
